title: Econometrics REITInflationPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the REIT-Inflation association analysis. Conducted comprehensive econometric analysis including correlation analysis, linear regression with robust standard errors, quantile regression, time series analysis (stationarity tests, Granger causality, rolling correlations), model diagnostics, and forecast evaluation. Found a strong positive association (correlation = 0.931) between inflation and REIT returns, with a 1% inflation increase associated with a 0.156 increase in REIT returns (41.7% of mean return). Generated 9 figures and produced a comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and policy/portfolio implications.
